policy: test:browser:routes and test:browser run once each, with no retries and no continue-on-error; the smoke runs even if the route check failed. CHEMIFREE_SMOKE_NO_SKIPS=1 fails the smoke if any step was skipped. The smoke's records are uploaded as the browser-smoke-attempt-<n> artifact whether it passed or failed, and a missing record fails the upload.

runs.cause: The smoke failed at start ('npm did not start'). In GitHub Actions, Vite colors its output even though it is piped, so the ready line never matched the pattern. The uploaded web.log showed the colored line. The failure was reproduced locally with FORCE_COLOR=1, and fixed by ignoring colors when matching (7dd4956).
